limits: Balance observations use simulated combat seconds and fixed-seed bots. They are not human enjoyment, population win rates, device FPS or full gameplay-parity measurements.
First-event and mutation medians include only observed events, with reach/unobserved counts retained; different suites/conditions remain separate.

Software Mobile emulator alone disables Swappy; physical ARM64/S23 performance/audio and Android 10/cutout acceptance remain unverified.
